So I can just say that, of course, we are always looking to any potential new area for is it's part of the strategy. [#564](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-564)
But we are very cautious with the use of the cash of the company. [#565](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-565)
And I'm not sure that we can talk about any kind of capital allocation when we see an acquisition of EUR 6 million in Malaysia. [#566](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-566)
So it is like a small bolt-on paid with the cash, so it does not change a lot, the situation and the capital allocation, I think. [#567](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-567)
So does it mean that you don't expect to invest a lot of millions in Asia in the next 1, 2 years? [#569](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-569)
Or because today, it's only EUR 6 million, but if you're ambitious, you will target something more important. [#570](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-570)
No. [#572](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-572)
And then I'm back to what I described as the result of the different market study, David. [#573](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-573)
That means that today, we -- the targets are very small and the market are totally fragmented. [#574](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-574)
So even if we wanted to push a lot and to be quite aggressive in the development of the business in Asia. [#575](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-575)
We don't have the target in the countries that we -- that we are highlighting. [#576](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-576)
So Malaysia, Singapore and so on. [#577](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-577)
So we will probably, in the coming years, still continue to make some small bolt-on to regularly develop this position. [#578](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-578)
But it is much more a strategy like Colombia than Mexico to give you a comparison of what we did in LatAm. [#579](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-579)
So Mexico, we had a very massive and super leader. [#580](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-580)
So it was a big move day on Colombia, we made the market study, but you had no leader clearly in place. [#581](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-581)
So it has been story of very small acquisitions, small bolt-on. [#582](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-582)
Now we are by far the leader in Colombia by the way, with a very nice margin. [#583](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-583)
but only with a very small move, some millions of revenue each time, but not more. [#584](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-584)
And it is probably the situation that we will have in the future in the country that we have targeted in Asia. [#585](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-585)
[Operator Instructions] As there are no further questions, I would like to hand back to Mr [#587](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-587)
Martire for closing remarks. [#588](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-588)
So I think that David gave the conclusion. [#590](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-590)
I wish everybody a wonderful summer and happy to see you in September, October and so on and for the Q3 performance of the group. [#591](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-591)
Bye-bye. [#592](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-592)
